effects: 7-hour operation · Dozens of targets · Missile & drone sites · Naval assets · Coastal defenses · Blockade resumes
iran: Threat, via Houthis, to close Bab el-Mandeb if power grid hit
tldr: Seven-hour operation while the US naval blockade formally resumed at 4pm ET. Iran relayed a threat that any US strike on its power grid would be answered by closing the Red Sea's Bab el-Mandeb.
